allow_large: Owner-approved 2026-09-29 for legacy clean-ups: pure removal of legacy/compat code, may exceed the fix file limit or touch interface paths
done_when: mcp_tool is gone from the binding kind union and from every branch and test, and stored definitions using it are rejected by the existing generic validation

dismissals.because: apps/core/test/integration/capability-binding-kind-validation.postgres.integration.test.ts:60 owner's standing rule (2026-09-29): pure legacy deletions get no end-to-end guard tests; unknown binding kinds are rejected by the existing generic validation, covered with neutral names

findings.body: The new Postgres test saves an invalid definition but calls `semanticCapabilityFromToolCatalogItem` directly at line 60. It never selects the stored tool for an agent or exercises the running API. The agent path in `apps/core/src/application/agents/agent-tool-runtime-rules.ts:135-149` parses selected tools and rejects invalid definitions; a regression in that wiring would leave this test green. Add a real-database API test that attempts to use the stored definition through that path and asserts rejection.
findings.title: Not done: end-to-end test that stored unsupported bindings cannot reach an agent

why: The old mcp_tool capability binding is kept only to be rejected, yet seven files still branch on it
